claims.claim_ar: «مَا» في (مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ) شرطيّة وهي في موضع نصب (بِيَفْتَحْ).
claims.claim_en: 'ma' in (مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ) is a conditional particle (شرطية) occupying the position of nasb (i.e. it functions as the conditional particle governing the verb 'yaf'tah').

claims.claim_ar: (مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ) تَبْيِينٌ لِـ «مَا»؛ أي أن (مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ) بيان لما يتعلق به حرف الشرط.
claims.claim_en: 'min rahmah' is a clarification (tabyin) of the conditional 'ma' — i.e. (min rahmah) specifies/clarifies what the particle pertains to.
